Commentary.Commentary: It was a good bowling performance by Australia. However, they were a bit sloppy in the field. Josh Hazlewood led the attack superbly in the absence of Mitchell Starc and bagged a 3-fer. Billy Stanlake, Pat Cummins and Travis Head did a decent job as well. The pitch looks like a good one for batting with fair bounce in it and Pakistan will have to bowl extremely well to defend their total. Do join us in a short while for the chase.

After losing Hafeez early, the pair of Sharjeel and Azam steadied the innings with a 49-run stand. The former got out soon after getting to his fifty but the latter continued to score freely. Babar was dropped on 30, 55 and 74 but still failed to get to his century. Shoaib Malik and Umar Akmal also looked in fine touch but they too failed to convert their starts and as a result, Pakistan managed a below par total.

Pakistan limp their way to a modest total! They will be very disappointed with their batting in the last 10 overs where they just managed 50 runs. It appeared as if they ran out of gas towards the business end.

He is claiming it but the umpires want to get it checked. The third umpire watches numerous replays before deciding that it's a clean catch. Babar Azam has to depart after a fine knock. A timely wicket for Australia.

Dug in short by Stanlake, Khan is quick to duck under it.
Good length outside off, Sharjeel is beaten again as he throws his bat at it.
NASTY! Short delivery and Khan gets a top edge when he tries to pull it and the ball hits the helmet. He looks fine though.
Length ball outside off, Khan tries to play at it but is beaten.
Short of a length outside off, Sharjeel hits it hard towards point but Maxwell leaps and saves a boundary.
Lands it full and outside off, Babar drives it to mid off. End of an eventful over, 7 runs and a wicket off it!

FOUR! Beautifully done! That's how you flick it. Full and angling in, Azam takes his front leg forward and across before clipping it off his pads through mid-wicket. Fine timing and it races through the gap.
Fullish on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
An overpitched delivery outside off, driven with superb timing through backward point. The third man fielder ran across to his right and tumbled to stop the ball. Saved two runs.
Wide! Digs in a bouncer but it's down the leg side. Azam leaves it.
Pitches it full and around off, Azam gets on the front foot and defends it solidly.
Babar Azam is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! Trapped in front! Hazlewood angles in a fuller length ball on middle and off, Hafeez gets across the stumps a bit in an attempt to flick it but misses and is rapped on the pads. They appeal and the finger goes up immediately. Hafeez decides not to review it and it's a good call. The replays confirm that it was plumb.
FOUR! THAT'S HIT AGAIN! Goodish length delivery outside off, Khan leans into and flicks it superbly past the mid on region for a boundary. That's 20 runs off the over.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Khan slices his attempted drive through covers and it loops over the point fielder for a boundary. Khan is taking on Stanlake.
FOUR! A beautiful delivery on a good length outside off and Sharjeel is lucky there. He tries to push it on the off side but edges it through the slip region for a boundary.
SIX! TOP SHOT! A short delivery and Sharjeel is quick to pick it up and pull it high over the mid-wicket region for a maximum.
Full and outside off, Sharjeel prods forward and defends it towards the on side.
A bit short this time and Sharjeel plays an unorthodox pull shot after shuffling. The ball is played through mid-wicket for a couple.
Goodish length outside off, Hafeez opens the face of the bat and plays it square on the off side for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Hafeez pushes it towards the point region.
Length ball outside off, Hafeez has left that alone.
WIDE! Outside off but this time it is too far and the umpire has signaled it a wide.
Dug in short, Hafeez ducks under it to let that through.
FOUR LEG BYES! Straight and drifting down the leg side, Hafeez is unable to flick it and the ball hits the pads and goes tickling fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery into the body, Hafeez stays deep in his crease but is unable to make contact and the ball hits the thigh pad.
Full and wide outside off, Sharjeel throws his bat at it and the ball floats over the mid off region for a couple.
A bit short into the body, Khan plays a pull shot towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! BANGED! Too full in length outside off, Sharjeel Khan drives it firmly straight down the ground for the first boundary of the day past mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharjeel stays in his crease to defend it but is beaten by the away swing.
Goodish length delivery outside off, Sharjeel does not go fetching for it.
Full length delivery outside off, Hafeez pushes it through covers for a single.
Billy Stanlake will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Angling into the pads, Sharjeel stays in his crease to defend that one.
Full delivery angling into the stumps, Hafeez pushes it towards the mid off region for a single.
Similar delivery outside off, Hafeez has left that alone.
Good length delivery outside off which nips away after pitching, Hafeez lets that through to the keeper.
Full length delivery outside off, Hafeez pushes it towards the point fielder.
Beautiful length ball outside off which nipped away after pitching, Hafeez tries to poke at it but the the ball sways away as he is beaten.

WIDE! Sliding down the leg side to start off with, Hafeez goes to flick it fine down the leg side but is unable to make contact. However, there is some sound and the keeper appeals. The umpire shows no interest and signals a wide. Strange call first up and Pakistan are off the mark!
The players are out in the middle. Sharjeel Khan and Mohammad Hafeez will open the innings for Pakistan. Josh Hazlewood will start the proceedings for Australia.
Australia - David Warner, Usman Khawaja, Steven Smith(c), Travis Head, Peter Handscomb, Glenn Maxwell, Matthew Wade(w), James Faulkner, Pat Cummins, Josh Hazlewood, Billy Stanlake.
Pakistan - Mohammad Hafeez(c), Sharjeel Khan, Babar Azam, Asad Shafiq, Shoaib Malik, Umar Akmal, Mohammad Rizwan(w), Imad Wasim, Mohammad Amir, Hasan Ali, Junaid Khan.

Toss - Australia win the toss and elect to field! As they have already declared, Peter Handscomb is making his ODI debut, replacing Mitchell Marsh while Billy Stanlake comes back in the playing XI, replacing Mitchell Starc. Pakistan on the other hand have decided not to tinker with their winning XI.

Hello and a warm welcome everyone for the third ODI between Australia and Pakistan in Perth. The visiting team finally managed to get off the mark on this tour in the last match and will be relieved more than happy at the moment. They would like to build a winning momentum from here on and take a lead in the series. Australia on the other hand will be hurt after the loss and would be eyeing a comeback today. With plenty at stake here, expect a cracking contest.
